READ ME --\> Remove ggplot grid, define y axis \## Story

Worldwide box office revenues were identified through https://www.boxofficemojo.com/year/world/.

Adjustments for inflation were made by referencing cumulative inflation figures from https://www.officialdata.org/us/inflation/.

I then used the Wayback Machine (https://web.archive.org/) to identify the Rotten Tomatoes critic and all-audience scores within the first 90 days of each movie's initial theatrical release.

I then identified whether movies were sequels or based on existing, well-known intellectual property at the time of theatrical release.
